entities.summary: Brestskaya Gazeta is a non-governmental newspaper from Brest, Belarus. Its first number came on 18 November 2002. The main language of the newspaper and its website is Russian, but some stories are written in Belarusian. Its latest issue is dated 30 December 2020.
